17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util;
18	
19	/**
20	 * Derives the stable {@code householdId} shared by owners that live in the same household,
21	 * i.e. that have the same last name and postcode. The identifier is a deterministic function
22	 * of those two values (the last name compared case- and whitespace-insensitively via
23	 * {@link TextNormalizer}), so every member of a household independently derives the same
24	 * identifier regardless of the order in which they are created.
25	 */
26	public final class HouseholdIdGenerator {
27	
28	    /** Number of hex characters kept from the digest; ample to avoid realistic collisions. */
29	    private static final int LENGTH = 12;
30	
31	    /** Separates the two key components so distinct pairs cannot collide by concatenation. */
32	    private static final String SEPARATOR = "|";
33	
34	    private HouseholdIdGenerator() {
35	    }
36	
37	    /**
38	     * Compute the stable household identifier for the given last name and postcode: the first
39	     * {@value #LENGTH} hex characters of SHA-256 over {@code normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode}.
40	     *
41	     * @param lastName the household's last name
42	     * @param postcode the household's postcode (a {@code null} postcode contributes an empty component)
43	     * @return an upper-case hex identifier that is identical for any two owners whose last name
44	     * normalizes to the same value and whose postcode is equal
45	     */
46	    public static String generate(String lastName, String postcode) {
47	        String key = TextNormalizer.normalize(lastName) + SEPARATOR + (postcode == null ? "" : postcode);
48	        return Sha256.hex(key).substring(0, LENGTH).toUpperCase();
49	    }
50	}

**Added a `Soundex` utility** (`util/Soundex.java`) — the standard American Soundex algorithm (first letter + three digits, h/w non-separating, vowels resetting) — since none existed. It sits in its own single-responsibility class alongside the other `util` helpers.
